calendar.matters:
ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Sep-06-2007 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name of a Minor.
Dept. 218, Commissioner: Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Patrick Heard.
Petitioner: Miao Yan Situ, present in pro per as Guardian ad litem for the Minor: Henny Vivian Zhou, and with Cantonese Interpreter: Charles Zhang.
No appearance by Co-Petitioner/Minor's Father: Xian Ke Zhou, but signed the Petition consenting to the name change.
Petitioner and Interpreter were sworn and examined.
No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct, and sufficient and that the petition should be granted.
The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of the Minor to: Vivian Wali Zhou.
Decree signed in open court.
